commitResults.messageTitle: Restore hover feedback on focused tutorial buttons
commitResults.messageBody:
The focused style shares the hover background, so hovering a focused
button produces no visible response.

Remove the focused background override and use an amber focus border
to keep keyboard focus visible while allowing independent hover feedback.

All 12 tutorial tests pass.
Ignore plus signs when matching phone numbers
Disable tutorial Up and Down arrow navigation

Command words reject uppercase and mixed-case input even though
several argument values already ignore case. This makes valid
commands such as ADD and Help fail unexpectedly.

Normalize command words with Locale.ROOT in parsing and error
handling so recognition and usage messages agree across locales.
Update the user guide and add regression tests for command casing,
argument preservation, and error usage.

Validation: gradlew check coverage passes with all 1,410 tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix event focus for mixed-case add commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Add-event commands accept mixed case, but the UI focus check is case-sensitive. This leaves the new event unselected for uppercase or mixed-case commands.

Match the command word without case sensitivity and cover event view switching and selection with a regression test.

Parameter prefixes require exact lowercase spelling, causing uppercase
and mixed-case variants to be rejected.

Match prefixes without case sensitivity and normalize parsed prefix
keys before validation and duplicate detection. Preserve parameter
values and the spelling of unknown prefixes in error messages.

Cover command variants and validation regressions with tests, and
document the accepted prefix syntax in the User Guide.

Validation: gradlew check passes all 1,412 tests, Checkstyle, and
coverage verification.
Data, preferences and log files are created in the terminal’s folder instead of the JAR’s folder

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove legacy reversed-prefix detection for events
commitResults.messageBody:
Event parsing rejects slash-leading words despite no longer supporting
reversed prefixes. Startup cleanup also removes events with these names.

Restrict the shared pattern to letters followed by a slash so event
commands and cleanup preserve slash-leading words as literal value text.
Update regression tests and the DG to describe the revised behavior.

Verify parsing, event operations, persistence, and startup cleanup with
260 passing tests. Checkstyle and the documentation build also pass.
